main_measure.name: pooled excess forward 5-bar return after forecast <= -10 (minus same coin/window mean forward 5-bar return), non-overlapping
main_measure.threshold: confirm if excess < 0 with t <= -2 and negative in >= 2 coins; reject if excess > 0 with t >= +2; inconclusive if -2 < t < +2 or fewer than 30 non-overlapping extreme cases

supporting_check.name: number of coins with negative mean excess forward return (need >= 2)

decided_by: The t-statistic lies strictly between -2 and +2, meeting the inconclusive rule.
reading: The holding baseline is the mean forward 5-bar return over every bar of the coin/window that has one, extreme cases are grid bars (positions 0,5,10,... per window) with forecast <= -10, and with only the coins present in the record the rule 'negative in at least 2 of the 3 coins' needs at least 2 of those coins negative, with a coin that has no cases not counting as negative.
